# Envoy MCP Tool Reference

Mutating TD-authoring operations are wrapped in TD undo blocks (one `batch_operations` call = one Ctrl+Z step); read-only tools, `run_tests`, `cook_op` and disk-only ops (`export_network`, `save_externalization`) are not. The contracts behind the multi-session, job, bridge and Convoy tools, and the fields that ride on every response (`_logs`, `_peers`, gates, `recovery_hints`, `_effects`), are in `references/coordination.md` in this skill's folder (`get_guidance(topic='mcp-tools-reference/coordination')` without a skills folder). The short version: a `LAYOUT WARNING`, `THREADING WARNING` or `MULTI-SESSION GATE` line in `_logs` is a hard stop, `_peers` with `conflict: true` is a hard stop, an `error` carries `error_code` plus `recovery_hints` to follow instead of retrying, and `_effects` on a write names the errors, fps drop and shader failures your write caused.

## Operator Management

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `create_op` | `parent_path`, `op_type`, `name?` | Create a new operator (e.g., `baseCOMP`, `noiseTOP`, `textDAT`, `gridPOP`). Auto-positions it and hugs any docked companions below it (`docks_placed`) |
| `create_extension` | `parent_path`, `class_name`, `name?`, `code?`, `promote?`, `ext_name?`, `ext_index?`, `existing_comp?`, `parent_shortcut?` | Create a TD extension: baseCOMP + text DAT + extension wiring |
| `delete_op` | `op_path`, `override?` | Delete an operator (multi-session gated; `override` bypasses, say so). Refuses the Embody COMP, its ancestors, `/` and Envoy's extension DAT |
| `copy_op` | `source_path`, `dest_parent`, `new_name?` | Copy operator to new location. Auto-positions the copy and hugs its docked companions (`docks_placed`) |
| `rename_op` | `op_path`, `new_name` | Rename an operator |
| `get_op` | `op_path`, `include_defaults?` | Returns NON-DEFAULT parameters by default (`include_defaults=True` for all); parameter-heavy COMPs are expensive (~3k+ tokens full), prefer `read_tdxn` for structure reads |
| `query_network` | `parent_path?`, `recursive?`, `op_type?`, `include_utility?` | Compact operator list: path/type/family/depth; name = last path segment. `include_utility=True` includes annotations |
| `find_children` | `op_path`, `name?`, `type?`, `depth?`, `tags?`, `text?`, `comment?`, `include_utility?` | Advanced search using TD's `findChildren` |
| `cook_op` | `op_path`, `force?`, `recurse?` | Force-cook an operator |

## Parameter Control

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `set_parameter` | `op_path`, `par_name`, `value?`, `mode?`, `expr?`, `bind_expr?` | Set value, expression, bind expression, or mode; rejects invalid Menu values with valid `menuNames`; sequence-block names auto-grow (`const5name` -> 6 blocks); reload and clone pulses on Envoy's own host are refused |
| `get_parameter` | `op_path`, `par_name?`, `search?`, `search_in?`, `depth?`, `max_results?`, `details?` | Single-parameter mode is compact by default (`path`, `parameter`, `value`, `mode`, `label`, mode-specific refs, `menuNames`); `details=True` restores default/style/range/menuLabels/menuIndex. Search mode (`search` glob or substring over `name`/`value`/`expr`/`any` across a subtree) ignores `details` |
| `describe_op_type` | `op_type`, `pattern?`, `page?`, `include_menus?` | Parameter names, labels, styles, creation defaults and menu values for an operator TYPE before it exists. Call it once per unfamiliar type instead of guessing a name into `set_parameter`; `pattern` globs names AND labels, `page` narrows; unknown type -> `did_you_mean`, empty match -> `hint`. Cached per type |

## DAT Content

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `get_dat_content` | `op_path`, `format?` | DAT text or table (`"text"`, `"table"`, `"auto"`), or `"stats"` to reduce a table to per-column stats + head/tail rows |
| `set_dat_content` | `op_path`, `text?`, `rows?`, `clear?`, `confirm_wipe?` | Full-replace DAT content. Refuses no-action calls and wipes (`text=""`, `rows=[]`, `clear=True`) unless `confirm_wipe=True`. For partial text edits prefer `edit_dat_content` |
| `edit_dat_content` | `op_path`, `old_string`, `new_string`, `replace_all?`, `confirm_wipe?` | Surgical text edit on a text DAT; `old_string` must appear exactly once unless `replace_all=True`; not-found errors include diagnostics. Tables go through `set_dat_content(rows=...)` |

## CHOP / POP Data

Reduced reads, never a blind dump: a 4x600 CHOP is 2,400 raw floats; these return shape and range.

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `get_chop_data` | `op_path`, `channels?`, `samples?`, `compare_to?` | Per-channel `min`/`max`/`mean`/`std`/`first`/`last`, capped at 32 channels. `channels` is a name glob; `samples>0` adds head/tail raw values; `compare_to` another CHOP adds a per-channel `diff` |
| `get_pop_data` | `op_path`, `attributes?`, `samples?`, `max_points?` | Point/prim/vert attribute metadata (~0.02 ms at ANY point count). Reading point VALUES is a GPU->CPU readback (~9.5 ms at 16k points, ~69 ms at 160k), so `samples>0` is opt-in and refused above `max_points` (default 50,000). `POP.points()` ignores its slicing arguments (verified 2025.33070), so the guard is on point count |

## Operator Flags, Positioning, Layout

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `get_op_flags` | `op_path` | All flags |
| `set_op_flags` | `op_path`, `bypass?`, `lock?`, `display?`, `render?`, `viewer?`, `current?`, `expose?`, `allowCooking?`, `selected?`, `cloneImmune?`, `componentCloneImmune?`, `showCustomOnly?`, `showDocked?` | Set one or more flags; a flag the operator cannot carry comes back in `unsupported_flags` |
| `get_op_position` | `op_path` | Position, size, color, comment |
| `get_network_layout` | `comp_path`, `include_annotations?` | Compact layout for all children: path/type/nodeX/nodeY/nodeWidth/nodeHeight plus `bounding_box`; docked ops carry `dockedTo`. Use instead of repeated `get_op_position` calls |
| `set_op_position` | `op_path`, `x?`, `y?`, `width?`, `height?`, `color?`, `comment?` | Set position, size, color (`[r,g,b]` 0-1) or comment. Moving a host re-hugs its docked companions (`docks_moved`); position the host before any explicitly-placed dock |
| `layout_children` | `op_path` | Auto-layout all children in a COMP |

## Annotations

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `create_annotation` | `parent_path`, `mode?`, `text?`, `title?`, `x?`, `y?`, `width?`, `height?`, `color?`, `opacity?`, `name?` | Create annotation (`"annotate"`, `"comment"`, `"networkbox"`); load `/manage-annotations` first |
| `get_annotations` | `parent_path` | All annotations with properties and enclosed operators |
| `set_annotation` | `op_path`, `text?`, `title?`, `color?`, `opacity?`, `width?`, `height?`, `x?`, `y?` | Modify annotation properties |
| `get_enclosed_ops` | `op_path` | Ops enclosed by an annotation, or annotations enclosing an op |

## Connections, Performance, Code

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `connect_ops` | `source_path`, `dest_path`, `source_index?`, `dest_index?`, `comp?` | Wire two operators; `comp=True` for COMP connectors |
| `disconnect_op` | `op_path`, `input_index?`, `comp?` | Disconnect an input |
| `get_connections` | `op_path` | All input/output connections, one input entry per connector |
| `get_op_performance` | `op_path`, `include_children?` | CPU/GPU cook times (ms), memory, cook counts |
| `get_project_performance` | `include_hotspots?` | Project FPS, frame time, GPU/CPU memory, dropped frames, active ops, GPU temp; optional top-N COMP hotspots |
| `run_soak_test` | `duration_s?`, `interval_s?`, `fps_target?`, `label?`, `stop?`, `idempotency_key?` | Background performance soak (job id back immediately; poll `get_job_status`). Samples the Perform CHOP on the frame hook without cooking or capturing anything; logs perturbing Envoy calls and excludes their 2 s neighborhood from the clean stats; finishes with trends, exact drops, GPU headroom, hotspots and a PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict. `stop=True` ends it early. See `/testing` |
| `execute_python` | `code` | Execute Python in TD; set `result` to return values. Lints created ops (`LAYOUT WARNING`) and worker-side `run()` (`THREADING WARNING`); refuses code that would destroy or reload Envoy's own host (`envoy.embody.host_destroy_refused`), where `me` and `parent()` ARE the Embody COMP |

## Introspection & Diagnostics

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `get_td_info` | _(none)_ | TD version, build, OS, Envoy version |
| `get_op_errors` | `op_path`, `recurse?` | Errors and warnings for op and children: cook errors, Python tracebacks (`kind: "script"`, invisible to `op.errors()`), and GLSL compile failures (`shaderErrors`) |
| `exec_op_method` | `op_path`, `method`, `args?`, `kwargs?` | Call a method on an operator (destroy-class methods on Envoy's host are refused) |
| `get_td_classes` | _(none)_ | All Python classes in the `td` module |
| `get_td_class_details` | `class_name` | Methods, properties, docs for a TD class |
| `get_module_help` | `module_name` | Python help text for a module |
| `get_docs` | `query`, `section?`, `source?`, `max_chars?` | Official TD docs: offline mirror first, docs.derivative.ca fallback; returns `title`, `source`, `sections_available`, `content`; ambiguous offline lookups return `matches` |
| `get_guidance` | `topic?` | THIS project's checked-in doctrine: the rules, the skills and their `references/*.md` (topic `<slug>/<file>`). Bare call lists topics; matching ignores case and punctuation. Worker-side, no TD round-trip. The only way clients with no skills folder (VS Code, Copilot, Windsurf) see them |
| `get_focus` | _(none)_ | What the user is looking at: `network`, `selected`, `current`, `rollover`, `target`. "This operator" means the SELECTED/current op, never the rollover |
| `get_sessions` | _(none)_ | Connected AI sessions, their recent scopes and claims, `you`, and the shared task ledger; check at session start and before destructive work |
| `claim_scope` / `release_scope` | `scope`, `note?`, `ttl?` | Cooperative WRITE lease on an op-path prefix, `file:<path>` or `project:<name>`; `project:worktree-*` claims are durable |
| `announce_task` / `update_task` | `title`, `scopes?`, `note?` / `task_id`, `status?`, `note?`, `commit?` | The shared task ledger: announce substantive work, then `done_uncommitted`, `committed` (sha) or `abandoned` |
| `preflight_landing` | `worktree_path` | Landing safety check for a worktree diff against main-tree dirt, peer claims and unsaved live TDXN state; run before porting any worktree diff |

## Embody Integration and TDXN

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `externalize_op` | `op_path`, `tag_type?` | Tag and externalize an operator to disk in one step (load `/externalize-operator` first) |
| `remove_externalization_tag` | `op_path`, `delete_file?` | Remove tracking (tag + row + TDXN breadcrumb); check `removed_anything`, not `removed_tags`, to confirm cleanup |
| `get_externalizations` / `get_externalization_status` | _(none)_ / `op_path` | All externalized operators / dirty state, build, timestamp, path for one |
| `save_externalization` | `op_path` | Force re-export an already-externalized operator |
| `read_tdxn` | `comp_path?`, `include_dat_content?`, `max_depth?`, `embed_all?` | **Preferred for reading >=3 operators**: the live network as a TDXN dict, ~20-90x fewer tokens than `get_op`+`query_network` walks. An authored-state snapshot, not a runtime probe: evaluated values, cook errors, output data, cook timing and runtime flags come from `get_parameter`, `get_op_errors`, `get_dat_content`/`capture_top`, `get_op_performance`, `get_op_flags` |
| `export_network` | `root_path?`, `include_dat_content?`, `output_file?`, `max_depth?`, `embed_all?` | Write `.tdxn` to disk; with `output_file` it returns a compact summary, not the document |
| `import_network` | `target_path`, `tdn`, `clear_first?`, `override?` | Recreate a network from a parsed TDXN document (gated with `clear_first=True`) |
| `diff_tdxn` | `target?`, `max_changed_ops?`, `max_bytes?` | What is UNSAVED in TDXN networks (live vs on-disk), the view git cannot give. Omit `target` for a whole-project summary; a COMP path or `.tdxn` file for one COMP in full (`old`=disk, `new`=live). Committed history: plain `git diff` |

`read_tdn` and `diff_tdn` remain as deprecated aliases.

## Capture, Logs, Jobs, Bridge

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `capture_top` | `op_path`, `format?`, `quality?`, `max_resolution?`, `inline?`, `sample_grid?` | Capture a TOP to a temp image (or an NxN RGBA grid with `sample_grid>=2`). The text carries a **Quality verdict** from the raw pixels: `FAIL` is a black, flat or fully-transparent frame. Never declare a visual task done on a FAIL |
| `capture_op` | `op_path`, `format?`, `quality?`, `max_resolution?`, `inline?` | Capture ANY operator: TOPs natively, every other family through a transient OP Viewer TOP |
| `get_logs` | `level?`, `count?`, `since_id?`, `source?` | Recent log entries from the ring buffer (200 entries; the log files in Embody's `Logfolder` hold the rest) |
| `run_tests` | `suite_name?`, `test_name?`, `override?`, `background?`, `idempotency_key?`, `confirm_saved?` | Embody unit-test suites; `background=True` (recommended for full runs) returns a job id |
| `get_job_status` | `job_id?` | Status of background jobs (`run_tests`, `save_project`, `update_embody`, `run_soak_test`); omit the id to list recent jobs |
| `save_project` | `idempotency_key?` | Save the project as a tracked job |
| `update_embody` | `idempotency_key?` | Self-update Embody as a tracked job |
| `get_td_status` | _(none)_ | Bridge-side: TD running, Envoy reachable, frozen-main-thread flags, instance registry, live sessions; works with TD down |
| `launch_td` / `restart_td` | `timeout?` | Launch or gracefully relaunch TD with the project's `.toe` |
| `list_dialogs` / `dismiss_dialog` | `instance?`, `screenshot?` / `instance?`, `dialog?`, `action?` | See and clear the modal dialog that is freezing TD; call `list_dialogs` FIRST when every tool times out |
| `switch_instance` | `instance?`, `all_sessions?` | List TD instances or re-pin this session; pass `instance=<name>` on any tool for a single call (`/multi-instance`) |
| `convoy_*` | see `references/coordination.md` | Seventeen LAN work-relay tools: pin a node with `convoy_select_node`, then ordinary tools run there |

## Batch Operations

| Tool | Parameters | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `batch_operations` | `operations`, `override?` | Several tool calls in one request; `operations` is a list of `{"tool": str, "params": dict}`; stops on the first error; one undo step |

Use it for 3+ calls to the same tool (positioning, connecting, parameter setting, flags); use `execute_python` when you need conditionals, loops or computed values between operations.

```json
{"operations": [
  {"tool": "set_op_position", "params": {"op_path": "/project1/noise1", "x": 400, "y": 0}},
  {"tool": "set_op_position", "params": {"op_path": "/project1/level1", "x": 800, "y": 0}},
  {"tool": "connect_ops", "params": {"source_path": "/project1/noise1", "dest_path": "/project1/level1"}}
]}
```

## MCP Prompts

`search_op(op_name, op_type?)`, `check_op_errors(op_path)`, `connect_ops()`, `create_extension_guide()` are guide prompts, not tools.
